T3 browser exclusion: a chrome process is excluded if its exe/realpath/args contain /.t3/ OR any process in its LIVE ancestor chain (walk ppid up to pid 1 via /proc/PID/stat, max 64 steps) is the T3 server (cmdline contains 't3' and 'serve') or has exe under ~/.t3/. C. Orphan (R5) = the browser root's ppid read directly from /proc/PID/stat equals 1. Nothing else counts as orphan (not "parent missing from procs"). Unreadable => not orphan.
D.
